    | text      = Matt Damon, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = So then the other 60% is dreams.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:30.779

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:31.840
    | text      = So dreams and movies are a very large part
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:36.020
    | text      = of what Info Wars is based on,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:37.960
    | text      = which is why it's funny that info is in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:40.520
    | text      = You know what's crazy,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:41.800
    | text      = and I'm gonna throw this out at you,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:43.420
    | text      = and this is actually science, all right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:47.180
    | text      = If you watch a lot of movies,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:49.140
    | text      = they will start to influence your dreams.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:51.420
    | text      = No. Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:52.979
    | text      = No. Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:24:53.899
    | text      = So maybe if you do this as your main information source,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = you might actually create a feedback loop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:00.300
    | text      = No, that's impossible.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's God.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:02.960
    | text      = I saw a movie about how that's impossible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:04.220
    | text      = I heard it in a dream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:09.100
    | text      = So Jack Pessoa comes on,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Rockin' to listen to any of him.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:11.840
    | text      = They just talk about how he needs to have barbecues
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:13.819
    | text      = in order to get people to Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:14.979
    | text      = I mean, I'm fine with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:16.619
    | text      = I guess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:17.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:18.300
    | text      = Then Steve Quayle comes on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:19.859
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:20.699

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:23.699

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:25.659
    | text      = so we're gonna move along.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:27.220
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:28.060
    | text      = So that was Sunday.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:28.939
    | text      = That's the day after he did his whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:31.020
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:31.859
    | text      = What a...

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:32.699
    | text      = Aliens and God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:33.539
    | text      = Take the day off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:34.619
    | text      = Aliens and God, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:35.460
    | text      = You had a big Saturday.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:36.619
    | text      = You should've taken Sunday off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:37.779
    | text      = Had to be there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:38.659
    | text      = So Monday's show is not that interesting at all,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:42.060
    | text      = so we're not gonna listen to much of it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:43.420
    | text      = with one major exception.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:45.159
    | text      = There's a whole lot of Alex whining about his CRO,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:47.739
    | text      = and of course, insisting that false flags
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:49.579
    | text      = are right around the corner,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:50.539
    | text      = bird flu is the new Ebola, and all that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:52.960
    | text      = But then, Alex has a guest on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:54.800
    | text      = who I was legitimately shocked to see.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:57.739
    | text      = Coming up, this is the way the planets align,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:25:59.699
    | text      = Victor Boot, who is very, very famous,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:08.699
    | text      = and you could also say infamous, like I am.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:11.739
    | text      = And I knew years ago,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:13.119
    | text      = I've been told he was a big listener,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:15.380
    | text      = but we've confirmed that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:17.380
    | text      = So he's coming on the show in 15 minutes,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:20.899
    | text      = and he says he'll stay with us as long as we want.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:22.300
    | text      = He speaks good English.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:23.539
    | text      = He's basically like Russia's version of Erik Prince.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:29.539
    | text      = I mean, that's about the closest thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:32.300
    | text      = I wouldn't say they're comparable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:33.899
    | text      = Prince had a much bigger operation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:36.220
    | text      = And does, and I've had a chance to talk to him,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:40.100
    | text      = interview him as well, but he's that type of character.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:43.859
    | text      = And then he spent a long time in U.S. prison
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:45.859
    | text      = on what I believe is a bunch of trumped-up garbage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:50.939
    | text      = I mean, everybody knows about the case,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:52.340
    | text      = the exchange, and all the rest of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:53.579
    | text      = You just said the earlier statement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:54.819
    | text      = Especially kidnapped by the DEA in another country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:26:59.460
    | text      = And so, of course, I told him the whole time,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:03.060
    | text      = just turn on Putin, and we'll let you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:04.739
    | text      = Of course, he never did that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:05.699
    | text      = So this is Victor Boot, a man who, until recently,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:08.699
    | text      = had been held in prison in the United States
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:11.020
    | text      = before being released as part of a prisoner exchange
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:13.220
    | text      = involving WNBA player Brittany Grinner.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:16.100
    | text      = Victor was in jail because he's been a giant arms dealer
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:19.140
    | text      = for the past 30 or so years
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:20.859
    | text      = who would regularly sell weapons to terrorist organizations.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:24.020
    | text      = His nickname is the Merchant of Death,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:26.140
    | text      = and the New York Times reported
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:27.579
    | text      = that he was one of the primary inspirations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:29.500
    | text      = for the main character in Nicolas Cage's 2005 movie
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:32.579
    | text      = about an amoral arms dealer, Lord of War.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:35.739
    | text      = He's a colossal piece of shit,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:37.180
    | text      = and even for Alex, this is a little bit much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:40.220
    | text      = I get that this program is currently obsessed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:42.300
    | text      = with carrying water for Putin and Russia,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:44.060
    | text      = but he's interviewing a guy who,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:46.220
    | text      = I'm just gonna read this from his indictment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:49.100
    | text      = Quote, Boot, an international weapons trafficker
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:51.779
    | text      = since the 90s, has carried out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:53.260
    | text      = a massive weapons trafficking business
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:55.060
    | text      = by assembling a fleet of cargo airplanes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:57.100
    | text      = capable of transporting weapons and military equipment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:27:59.819
    | text      = to various parts of the world,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:00.939
    | text      = including Africa, South America, and the Middle East.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:04.140
    | text      = The arms that Boot has sold and brokered
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:06.380
    | text      = have fueled conflicts and supported regimes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:08.619
    | text      = in Afghanistan, Angola, the Democratic Republic of Congo,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:11.819
    | text      = Liberia, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, and Sudan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:15.300
    | text      = Not only is Boot a death profiteer,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:18.060
    | text      = he does exactly what Alex claims the globalists do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:21.699
    | text      = From the New York Times, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:23.420
    | text      = according to several investigations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:25.140
    | text      = and his US indictment, he and his associates
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:27.420
    | text      = flouted arms embargoes in Sierra Leone,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:29.779
    | text      = the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Algeria,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:32.180
    | text      = where he sold weapons to both the government forces
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:35.060
    | text      = and the rebels fighting them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:37.300
    | text      = I don't know what else to say, but fuck this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:40.539
    | text      = It's one thing for Alex to try to launder
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:42.380
    | text      = Russian thought leaders who have ideological agendas,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:45.060
    | text      = but it's entirely another thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:46.420
    | text      = for him to give a glory interview to the merchant of death
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:49.579
    | text      = who was recently released from US custody,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:51.819
    | text      = just barely a year ago in a prisoner exchange with Russia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:55.140
    | text      = Fuck this shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:56.100
    | text      = This is ridiculous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:57.659
    | text      = Unacceptable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:28:59.460
    | text      = I mean, I don't even know...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:04.420
    | text      = Like...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:05.260
    | text      = We're having so much fun with silicon aliens.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:07.180
    | text      = This was...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:08.020
    | text      = This crashed Earth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:09.539
    | text      = This is some serious whiplash.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:11.939
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:12.779
    | text      = That is absolute insanity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:14.899
    | text      = He shit at that...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:17.060
    | text      = But he's been in prison for 30 years?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:19.340
    | text      = How long?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:20.180
    | text      = No, no, not that long.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:21.260
    | text      = How long has he been in prison?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:22.579
    | text      = I think something to the tune of 10-ish.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:25.699
    | text      = 10 years?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:26.539
    | text      = All right, so he's not that connected anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:28.579
    | text      = No, he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:29.859
    | text      = Oh, he's still connected?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:31.380
    | text      = He got released as part of the prisoner exchange.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:34.060
    | text      = Well, yeah, but I mean, that's just a thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:37.140
    | text      = Like, he's not in active business still, you know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:41.140
    | text      = What, is he bored?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:45.060
    | text      = I'm trying to figure out why he's here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:47.899
    | text      = You know what I'm saying?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:48.979
    | text      = Like, what is...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:49.939
    | text      = What, beyond this guy being a fucking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:52.300
    | text      = having a great day psycho,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:54.220
    | text      = is there for him to be on Info Wars?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:56.899
    | text      = We will see.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:29:57.739
    | text      = Other than like a either direct pawn of Putin,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:01.739
    | text      = or...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:03.500
    | text      = Fuck it, I'm having a good day today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:05.300
    | text      = I'm out of prison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:06.460
    | text      = I think it might be more the first one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:07.939
    | text      = All right, well, that makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:10.060
    | text      = There's definitely an agenda
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:11.300
    | text      = that he is working in service of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:14.859
    | text      = And to be clear, he was not kidnapped by the government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:18.340
    | text      = He was caught in a sting operation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:19.939
    | text      = where he believed that he was selling arms
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:21.340
    | text      = to a Colombian rebel group,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:22.739
    | text      = but he was actually talking to an undercover agent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:25.140
    | text      = So he got caught because he was trying to sell arms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:27.819
    | text      = Because he's an arms dealer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:28.819
    | text      = That's such a great sting thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:30.699
    | text      = People should do those stings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:32.819
    | text      = Don't do the other stings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:33.979
    | text      = That's a good sting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:35.779
    | text      = So Alex is talking to this guy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:39.340
    | text      = who's a gigantic Russian arms dealer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:30:42.579
    | text      = Again, this is really terrifying.
}}
